decisions.reason: The DPA management software has only one vague but positive customer signal and a clear agency niche, and as software it costs little to keep, so the option stays open while its value is still uncertain.
The hosting management platform is featured on the home page, which suggests it is central to the firm's offering, and one year of results is too little to justify abandoning it.
The configurable managed hosting plan fits the firm's core hosting business and is cheap to keep alongside the platform, and there is no evidence yet that its value will not be realized.
